description: ARRANGES cards already on a board. "auto" (default) lays each section (group) out as its own block, notes in columns and pictures in rows, every picture whole, and sets the sections out to suit the board; it also brings notes the API made earlier up to date. order lists card ids to put first. "justified" fits rows flush on both edges, "masonry" is colour-ordered columns, "grid" uniform cells, "row" and "column" single lines. Omit card_ids for the whole board.

columns.description: Column cap, grid and masonry only

draft.description: The draft key create_boards returned. Pass it on every call about that draft.

order.description: Card ids to put first, in order. Those in no section come first, at the top-left

width.description: Block width (not auto); default roughly square

name: arrange_board
title: Arrange board
